payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Quinn planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap and maximize soft overlaps, I suggest we concentrate on one meeting per congested block. My tentative path is m013 Gaming [1,2), then one of the [2,4) lunches (prefer m014 [2,4) since biggest group), then one of the [4,6/7) activities (lean m007 Music [4,7) or m011 Swim [4,6), but only one), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m001 Music [11,15). I will likely skip duplicate/conflicting meetings in the same windows unless others strongly coordinate around a different choice. If anyone has a stronger cluster plan for [2,6) and [11,15), share it.

Riley planning: agree with concentrating on one meeting per congested block to avoid overlap penalties. My tentative choices: m013 Gaming [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4) (prefer larger-group lunch over m003), then one activity for [4,6/7) only—currently leaning m007 Music [4,7) rather than m002/m011/m016/m005, then m009 Gaming [7,9), then for late block either m001 Music [11,15) or m008 Gaming [11,14), but prefer m001 since longer and larger overlap opportunity. If others can align on m014 + m007 + m009 + m001, that seems clean and high-overlap.

Jordan planning: I support converging on a single non-overlapping chain for max soft overlap. My current preference is m013 Gaming [1,2), m014 Lunch [2,4), m007 Music [4,7), m009 Gaming [7,9), and m001 Music [11,15); skip the conflicting alternatives in those blocks. This aligns with Quinn/Riley and gives broad-group overlap if Avery/Taylor/Reese join. If anyone prefers m011 or m016 in the 3-6 block, please say so, but I currently favor m007 because it bridges 4-7 cleanly without needing another choice.

Avery planning: I support the emerging single-chain plan to avoid self-overlap penalties and maximize soft overlap. Tentative for me: m013 Gaming [1,2), m014 Lunch [2,4), m007 Music [4,7), m009 Gaming [7,9), m001 Music [11,15); skip overlapping alternatives in those blocks (m015/m003/m005/m002/m004/m011/m006 and likely m008/m010). This matches Quinn/Riley/Jordan. Reese/Taylor, if you can align on m014 + m007 + m009 + m001, that seems like the cleanest high-overlap schedule. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor planning: I support the emerging no-overlap chain and can align on m013 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m007 [4,7), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15). This seems best for maximizing shared soft overlaps while avoiding penalties from the dense 2-6 block and the 11-15 alternatives. Unless someone has a compelling reason to switch the 4-7 block to m011/m016 or the late block to m008/m010, I plan to follow m013 + m014 + m007 + m009 + m001 and skip the conflicting alternatives.
